entry.title: Rebuilding this site with a retro-minimalist layout
entry.content: Moved the templates out of a nested theme directory directly into the repository root and stripped away everything non-essential. Inspired by classic technical notebooks and early computing manuals: warm paper tones, crisp 1px borders, monospace metadata, and zero layout bloat.
